patches.reason: Protect version diagnostics, remove internal config/WebSocket routes and omit secret/raw-payload logs without altering sandbox isolation.
patches.licenseImpact: Modified upstream source remains MIT; original LICENSE and applicable NOTICE stay byte-identical. New Code Startrack regression tests retain Apache-2.0 attribution.

patches.reason: Set and measure PR_SET_DUMPABLE=0 inside the final credential-bearing Linux go-judge executable, because execve resets launcher-only hardening. A failed syscall/readback stops startup before main. No sandbox role or namespace/capability boundary is weakened.
patches.licenseImpact: New Code Startrack Linux startup integration source is separately Apache-2.0 attributed; original upstream files and MIT license remain unchanged.
patches.upgradeCondition: Retain until a reviewed exact upstream executable measures nondumpability after exec. Verify actual sibling /proc memory/environment denial and final runtime PID under the released Linux profile; portable compilation is insufficient.

patches.reason: Assemble a fixed embedded workload-only namespace guard with the pinned Elastic API and supply it through both existing linuxcontainer builder paths and ExecveParam.Seccomp. Preserve the unchanged broad init whitelist and trusted clone3(CLONE_INTO_CGROUP) setup; only workload unshare/setns, namespace clone flags and clone3 are restricted. Workload clone3 returns ENOSYS for libc fallback; conditional clone is terminal to avoid pinned assembler accumulator fall-through changing ordinary syscalls. Refuse disabled or caller-replaced init policies.
patches.licenseImpact: Modified upstream env source remains MIT with prominent Code Startrack comments and byte-identical upstream LICENSE/NOTICE. New fixed profile, assembler integration and inert VM regression tests are separately Apache-2.0 attributed. No custom BPF or isolation implementation is introduced.
patches.upgradeCondition: Rebase only against reviewed exact go-judge and go-sandbox pins. Inspect both builder paths, inherited init-profile identity, mature final-exec seccomp ordering, assembler argument accumulator and clone ABI. Rerun actual loader VM ordinary-syscall/clone/clone3/x32/foreign-architecture stack regressions, source/license closure and final Linux compiler/reference/validator/thread/fork/verdict/isolation matrix with at least three workload filters. Portable VM tests do not establish Linux installation or sandbox acceptance.
